universe.source_universe: all 5m market windows with original independently verified rules and token IDs
universe.full_denominator: including NO_SIGNAL NO_BOOK NO_FEE STALE GAP MISSED_WINDOW ABSTAIN and ZERO_FILL

decision_time.required: T0 original raw bytes, local receive time strictly before outcome; immutable rule, both CLOB books + fee per token, native 300s SENEX score or explicit NO_SIGNAL
decision_time.source_requirement: independently attested exact BTC/USD TWAP60 AND finalized market-specific settlement

hypotheses.null: E[C net - B net] <= 0 per complete preregistered opportunity
hypotheses.alternative: E[C net - B net] > 0 after observed costs and uncertainty

B_MARKET_PRIOR.policy: T0 executable two-token market quotes only, fixed training-estimated rules; no future quotes

C_SENEX_CALIBRATED.policy: genuine causal native 5m score; fit only train/calibration; otherwise ABSTAIN

costs.fee: exact market-specific T0 per-token frozen fee schedule with explicitly tested precision
costs.slippage: pre-committed pessimistic levels; not calibrated on OOS
costs.book: ask-side depth and max market impact, no midpoint
costs.fill: paper quote is not real fill
costs.normalization: net USDC per opportunity fixed hypothetical stake, independent capital authority not conferred

splits.train: first chronological 60% of candidate days (design only)

inference.confidence: 95% cluster bootstrap with deterministic preregistered seed
inference.multiplicity: Holm over absolute and incremental primary hypotheses
inference.calibration_metrics: train-only Brier/ECE, never for OOS tuning
inference.decision: both multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence limits > 0 and robust to slippage/fee stress
